Hello @poojaranjan ,
we want to share few updates from EIPsInsight.

- EIPs Label Distribution chart [Link](https://eipsinsight.com/Analytics)
- Transactions Trend (number of transactions of each type) [Link](https://eipsinsight.com/testv2)
- Gas Metrics Trends (Base fee, Priority fee, gas burnt, Gas used vs time) [Link](https://eipsinsight.com/testv2)
- EIPsInsight Monthly Report [Link](https://eipsinsight.com/insight/2025/4)
- EIPsInsight Monthly Report tweet (published at the end and middle of each month): [Link](https://x.com/teamavarch/status/1912480523576046022?s=46)

Please take a moment to share your feedback on the new look of the EIPs website. If you’d like to suggest any changes or notice any bugs, let us know!

We’re planning to make the switch decision in the next meeting if everything looks good and is widely accepted.

🔗 https://eips-wg.github.io/EIPs/20/

## Notes

### Next steps

- Gajinder to add a comment and try to merge PR #8741 for EIP-196.
- Sam to force merge PR #9625 for EIP-3607.
- Sam to close issue #381 regarding changing the reference implementation.
- Victor to document and reply on the Ethereum Magicians forum with the suggestion to change "Decline for Inclusion" to "Defer for Inclusion".
- EIPsInsight team to get in touch with the Hoodi team for suggestions on data to track for the Hoodi testnet dashboard.
- Viwin to check the code base for any errors regarding RIP changes in the monthly EIP report.
- Reviewers to start leaving comments on calls for input to work towards becoming editors.
- EIP editors and community members to test and provide feedback on the new version of the [EIPs website](https://eips-wg.github.io/EIPs/20/) developed by Sam Wilson.
- Sam to create a call for input for the new EIPs website.

### Summary

#### Discuss Open Issue & Pull Requests
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8741
  - Sam and Gajinder expressed uncertainty about the correctness of an update requested to EIP 196, and Pooja suggested that approval from the authors of EIP 196 would be beneficial.
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/9539
  - Spam, deleted
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9625
  - Merged
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9550
 - Merged
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9517
 - Merged
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9477
 - Merged
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9614
 - Merged
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9638
  - Merged
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9596 
  - Closed on Authors' request
- https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/970
  - Merged 
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9639
  - Merged

#### Call For Input
- They also discussed Call for Input issue that was rejected. 

#### EIP Stage Tracking Proposal Discussion
- Pooja proposed an idea of [including a preamble header](https://hackmd.io/@poojaranjan/EIPTemplateImprovementProposal) called stage in the EIP-template, which was discussed in a [fellowship of ethereum magician post authored by Tim Beiko](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/reconfiguring-allcoredevs/23370).
- Pooja proposed adding a preamble field called "Stage" to the eip template to track the history of eip consideration for inclusion in network upgrades. The field would include the upgrade name, Meta EIP link, and network upgrade stage. 
- Gajinder expressed concerns that this might negatively impact the perception of proposals that have been deferred multiple times, and suggested that only the final status should be recorded.
- Victor suggested changing the "decline" status to "deferred", which was agreed upon by both Gajinder and Pooja. They also discussed the possibility of adding a rejected status for proposals that are not considered at all. Pooja proposed using the Ethereum Magician page to discuss and finalize these changes.
- Sam opposed the idea due to concerns about permissions and responsibilities. 
- Sam suggested that the authors or editors of a proposal should be responsible for updating the 'stages' field, but this could lead to misleading information. 
- Pooja suggested that the responsibility could lie with the authors and verification could be done through a backlink to the Meta EIP. Sam agreed that there could be a solution and emphasized the need for UI work to display the stages of proposals.

#### Meta EIP Upgrade Frequency Discussion
- Pooja discussed the need for updating the Upgrade Meta EIP for any upgrade every week. Gajinder questioned the necessity of this task, and Pooja clarified that it will be necessary to reflect the correct stage of each EIP in discussion.
- Gajinder expressed concerns about having multiple Meta EIP for the same upgrade, which could cause confusion. Sam agreed, citing the example of a contentious EIP with different camps wanting a hard fork with or without it. Pooja acknowledged the issue and the need for a general agreement among all clients.
- Pooja, Gajinder, and Sam discussed maintaining EIPs stages and the potential for auto-populating fields by the code. Pooja agreed that this could be done and open to the idea of UI to show the history of EIPs stages. 
- They also discussed the possibility of updating the "deferred for inclusion" status instead of "declined for inclusion". 

#### Stagnant Bot
Viwin mentioned that they would work on the stagnant bot issue before the next meeting. 

#### EIP Editing Office Hour Every Week
- Pooja announced that there would be an EIP editing office hour every week, with alternate weeks dedicated to EIP only and EIP + ERC.

#### EIPsInsight updates
- Viwin presented updates to EIPsInsight, including a new chart for [PRs count based on labels](https://eipsinsight.com/Analytics) and a new page for [tracking transaction trends](). The new page currently tracks data for the past 24 hours and includes charts for base fee, priority fees, and gas used and gas burn. Viwin requested input on how to make the system more useful for the Ethereum community. Pooja suggested adding a chart to show the trend of different EIPs over time.
- The group followed updates on the EIP dashboard and monthly report. 
- Pooja inquires about the lack of changes in RIPs, and Viwin agrees to check the codebase for any errors. 

#### How a Reviewer can become an Editor?
- Mercy enquired about the process of reviewers becoming editors, with Pooja explaining that reviewers' work is monitored for six months before they can propose themselves as editors, subject to approval from current editors.
- Sam suggested to actively participate in Call For Input as well.

#### New Website Update 
- In the meeting, Sam mentioned the new version of the EIPs website and sought feedback on whether to switch to it. 
- Pooja suggested including this as a decision-making point in the next meeting.

##### The next meeting is scheduled for May 21st at 1,400 UTC..
